checklist: IMMEDIATE LATERAL SLIDE / NO UPRIGHT HOLD

PARTIAL. Time with the trunk within 30° of vertical after the fold-side landing: 0.12 / 0.23 / 0.26 s (SP2F 0.40 / 0.42 / 0.46 s). It is no longer a hold: the trunk arrives leaning toward the TACKLING side (SP2C's in-air counter-lean, which lands the pelvis on the folded side) and now swings through vertical once, onto the folded side, as the hand lands. The pelvis rolls onto the folded side progressively (≈ 20° at landing → ≈ 30° at +0.5 s → 50–58° at +1.0 s). Leaning onto the folded side in the air (as REFERENCE3 does) would remove the rest, but it twists the folded knee further past its stop (log §4).
REMAINS LATERAL (no excursion toward seated-upright or chest-down once established)

YES. After the lateral slide is established (+0.56 / 0.56 / 0.48 s) excursions: 0.0 / 0.0 / 0.0 s; chest-down never; the folded-side shoulder and hip stay the lower ones 100% of the time; lying direction ψ stays within 42…59° / 28…47° / 0…43° (0 = on the folded side, 90 = on the back) — one continuous side / back-side manifold.
TORSO LOWERS PROGRESSIVELY WITHIN THAT MANIFOLD
YES. Trunk tilt after establishment 56 → 71° / 56 → 75° / 51 → 85°; no backward rock larger than 2.7° (SP2F 5.5°).
NO DISCRETE FALL-OVER MOMENT

YES by the traces: peak trunk rate after landing 120 / 133 / 182°/s (SP2E 263 / 239 / 324); the 5.5 m/s peak is the swing through vertical at ≈ +0.1 s, not a fall; landing pelvis-roll kick -98 / -75 / -64°/s (SP2F -179 / -245 / -267). Please judge the 5.5 m/s landing visually.
POSTING ARM REACHES THE TURF ONCE AND ESTABLISHES SUPPORT
HAND / FOREARM STAYS IN SLIDING CONTACT (hard requirement)
YES. Continuous from first contact to the end of the slide (1.91 / 2.15 / 2.47 s), no gaps at any speed and in none of the 27 perturbed runs; it slides 3.26 / 4.25 / 5.42 m along the turf.
HAND REPEATEDLY TOUCHING / LEAVING

NO (diagnosed and corrected: the early variants' hover / rebound came from a reach target that finished before contact and held the hand ≈ 1 cm up through the 80 ms target blend, and at 5.5 m/s a 46 ms rebound after the first-touch impact; fixed by a reach still moving at contact, a 30 ms blend and the contact press).
ARM GEOMETRY ADAPTS AS THE TORSO LOWERS

YES. No authored arm angles after contact. Shoulder elevation 46° → 107° → 124° (5.0 m/s); the elbow straightens within ≈ 0.3 s and stays nearly straight (a long arm, as in REFERENCE3); normal load varies continuously (see plots). The hand is part of the forearm body (no wrist joint), so wrist / hand organisation is not represented.
ARM DOES NOT HOLD THE TORSO UP

YES (qualified). The press is a two-sided load-aware regulator around the intended lowering: 34–126 N (mean 63) / 46–130 N (mean 71) / 63–130 N (mean 97); lowest when the trunk is behind its intended lowering, so the descent continues (trunk to 71 / 75 / 85°). Shoulder effort mean 0.37 / 0.42 / 0.47 of capacity (SP2F's constant 150 N press: 0.56 / 0.57 / 0.59).
NO RIGID PROP / NO POSE LOCK / NO HAND CONSTRAINT

YES. After contact the arm has only its joint damping, the regulated press (Jacobian transpose) and a soft end-range shoulder stabiliser that acts only beyond 115° elevation (≤ 60 N·m, scaled by authority). Finite M1c muscles; contacts win.
NO ARM FLOATING · NO CHEST-FIRST ROLL · NO PASSIVE RAGDOLL
YES. Chest-down never (also 0 / 27 perturbed runs); no regional failure, no whole-body fallback, authority ≥ 0.54.
FOLDED-LEG / TACKLE ENTRY PRESERVED

PARTIAL. Tuck, boot, studs (0 stud steps) and the knee position at contact are unchanged, BUT the folded knee's tibial axial rotation goes past its hard stop by 7.6 / 6.4 / 5.1° for 0.24–0.36 s at the landing (SP2F 1.7 / 1.0 / 1.5°, SP2E 4.0 / 4.2 / 1.1°): releasing SP2C's counter-lean in the air changes how the folded shin lands.
PHYSICAL SLIDE PRESERVED
YES. 4.09 / 5.33 / 6.79 m (SP2F 4.10 / 5.38 / 6.75 m); horizontal closure ≤ 0.0040 N·s; deterministic (badcc352f5a35170 ×2).

reference: REFERENCE3 (as recorded): the slider goes onto his folded side DURING the drop (the trunk already tilted ≈ 30–45° toward the folded side when the hip lands), the folded-side hand reaches the turf at about the hip landing, a long, nearly straight arm out to the side / behind, and the body then slides on that side with the trunk lowering slowly while the arm opens; the other arm is raised (incidental, not copied).
changes: Lateral establishment: SP2C's in-air counter-lean is released earlier (lumbar / thoracic lateral flexion toward the folded side over 0.25 → 0.40 s, thoracic-led) so the trunk swings onto the folded side as it lands, then continues along the slow recline (one curve, no pause).
Posting arm reach: still moving toward the turf through the contact (0.25 → 0.70 s), targets released 30 ms after the first forearm contact.

Active load-aware arm support (new opt-in sp2_ctrl post.support): the press is a two-sided feedback of the sensed trunk lowering (tilt + 0.12 s × rate, 25 ms sensing delay, 40 ms activation) against the SAME intended lowering the trunk targets follow: 130 N on the intended lowering, down to 30 N when the trunk is behind it (yields to the descent), up to 300 N if it runs ahead (brakes a fall). A soft end-range shoulder stabiliser stops the turf dragging the arm overhead (it buckled the elbow at 4.5 m/s).
Final organisation: pelvis-roll objective to 70° (SP2F 75°) — robust: with the earlier lateral establishment 75° rolled the body chest-down at 5.5 m/s in nearby variants.
Persistent-lateral-orientation diagnostic (pelvis roll, chest normal, trunk roll, shoulder / hip heights, contact regions, classification) and arm effort / load series added to the evaluation.
notes: First touch of the hand is an impact: 2.64 / 2.03 / 2.00 BW for one 8 ms sample as the leaning trunk lands onto the arm (SP2F 1.25 / 0.64 / 0.78); afterwards the load is 0.1–0.15 BW on average.

The pelvis reaches its side more slowly than the trunk: the trunk is lateral from ≈ +0.15–0.25 s, the pelvis roll passes 35° only at ≈ +0.5 s (my diagnostic's 'established' therefore reads +0.48–0.56 s).
The trunk ends propped at ≈ 70–85° tilt on the long arm (REFERENCE3 also ends propped on the arm); it does not lie flat within the slide.
5.5 m/s: peak trunk rate 182°/s at the swing through vertical (+0.1 s). 4.5 m/s: the shoulder opens to ≈ 134° before the end-range stabiliser holds it.
Friction F37.5 is temporary and unchanged; nothing calibrated. The first-pass SP2F (28491975) is preserved unchanged.
